title: Emergency fund money for March 2026 storm damage
summary: Officials expect to return sometime in fiscal 27 with a budget amendment to cover the funding need. In April, the committee cut the emergency fund by the $32 million already authorized for the storms, and the budget director said that $32 million is not available. A bill raising the emergency amount from $12 million to $32 million was set for second reading May 1st.
